Hero_Desc_Coffe:
Coffe, a coffee spirit who dreams of becoming the finest barista in Elias.
Every day, she strives not merely to do her job well, but to do it perfectly.
In her heart, she wishes happiness for everyone who drinks her coffee.
Album_Like_Coffe: Perfect coffee; desserts that go well with coffee
Album_Hate_Coffe: Putting strange things in coffee; disrespecting coffee
Album_Wish_Coffe: For every customer who visits the cafe to leave happy
Album_Coffe1: Coffe takes great pride in being a barista. Even a polite thank-you for listening makes her puff up and claim she does everything perfectly. Still, her coffee really is good, so let's let it slide.
Album_Coffe2: Coffe rarely makes mistakes at work, but she is often scatterbrained in daily life. She struggles with food that doesn't use coffee or have anything to do with it, and frequently forgets things, making extra work for herself.
Album_Coffe3: Coffe apparently sleeps in a tiny room behind the cafe. I worried whether she could sleep properly in such a cramped space, but she said she used to live somewhere much smaller. Where on earth was that?
Album_Coffe4: Coffe says she never took a break before coming to the Fairy Kingdom. She was always so busy making coffee that she didn't know how to relax. Lately, though, she sometimes tells me how much fun she had playing with other spirits.
Album_Coffe5: Coffe loves every kind of coffee: warm iced Americanos, frappes, even mysterious coffee mixed with cartoon meat and animal feed. She proudly says a special customer freed her of all prejudice against coffee... Well, she's happy, so let's leave it at that.
Album_Coffe6: Coffe confided that her coffee no longer seems simply perfect to her. She now believes truly perfect coffee should reach apostles she hasn't met yet and give their hearts a little breathing room. Seeing her declare that she would never give up, however hard it gets, made me proud.
Album_Coffe7: I spotted Coffe muttering to herself during a walk. She seemed to be wondering how to create an aroma that would draw people to her cafe from any distance. If I find a wonderfully fragrant ingredient in the banquet hall, I'll quietly let her know.
LoveHero_Coffe: Hehe! Whether you need coffee or someone to talk to, just let me know!
LoveHeroCancel_Coffe: Ugh... I believe you'll come back again...!
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Hate1: She tried hard to pair it with coffee, but concluded that seaweed salad simply didn't go with it and stared at the dish uneasily.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Hate2: She peered at the creme brulee curiously, then frowned. She complained that the acrid smell of gunpowder would overpower the coffee's aroma.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like1: Her eyes sparkled as she savored the aroma and slowly tasted it. After draining the cup, she praised it as a masterpiece anyone would love.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like10: She happily said that a coffee recipe using this ingredient could make every customer happy.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like2: She praised it as an excellent side dish for any coffee, from a clean Americano to a sweet frappe.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like3: She kept chewing after taking a bite of the white rice cake. Fascinated by its chewy texture, she repeatedly asked how it was made.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like4: She said its gentle sweetness would go well with an Americano, then handed me one. Before I knew it, we were enjoying the food and coffee together.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like5: She took a big mouthful and her eyes went wide. She said just a little was enough to wake her right up.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like6: She ate a songpyeon from each hand and looked astonished. In a rapid burst, she said she was amazed first by the beautiful colors, then by the equally varied fillings.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like7: She asked what the chocolate was made of, so I told her. She cheered that this chocolate would let her make chocolate lattes beastkin could drink too.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like8: While happily eating, she suddenly said she felt a surge of energy. Brimming with confidence, she declared she could hold coffee giveaways in every region.
Food_ChefNote_Coffe_Like9: She turned the candies over, delighted by their cute shapes. She happily said the flavors were just as varied, making them twice as fun to eat.

LoveLetter_Coffe:
Hello, Master!

Business at the cafe is going well today too! Lately, customers often thank me for listening so carefully. I think it's thanks to all that training I did under your guidance. Thank you for taking my hand when I needed help back then. I still feel grateful every day!

Ehehe, I know I'm always saying thank you, but writing it out in a letter like this makes me a little shy. Anyway, have another wonderful day!
LoveCall_Coffe:
Um... Will this call go through...? Oh, you picked up!
Hello, Master! It's Coffe!

Why am I calling? Oh, well... this may be a bit sudden...
Master, is anything troubling you? I've noticed you looking deep in thought quite often lately.
If something is worrying you, please visit my cafe anytime! If you need someone to listen, I'm always happy to be that person.

Of course... I might not have a perfect, wise answer to your problems. But... making you delicious coffee and quietly listening are things I can do well! You always put my heart at ease, and I want to do the same for you. So... whenever your heart feels heavy, come see me, Coffe!
